description: List documents for a symbol. Retrieve a list of available documents (filings, transcripts, reports) for a given symbol → Returns [{id: string, title: string, category: string, reported_time: number, is_available: boolean, is_pdf: boolean, fiscal_period?: string, fiscal_year?: number, form?: string}]. Use the id field with get_document to read content.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: get_documents
